title: An Accurate and Single-Communication Federated Inference Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2608.27063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Joint analyses across multiple institutions are increasingly important in biomedical and epidemiological research, particularly for rare diseases where datasets are typical small. However, privacy regulations and institutional policies often prevent the sharing of individual-level patient data. In this paper we present an accurate and single-communication federated inference algorithm. Single-communication federated inference enables statistical analyses through a single exchange of summary statistics between participating centers and a coordinating server, preserving privacy while reducing communication and computational costs compared with iterative federated learning. We extend a recently proposed single-communication federated inference strategy that is based on second-order Taylor expansions by using third-order expansions to better approximate local log-likelihood functions. translated_title: 一种准确且单次通信的联邦推理算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27063v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：跨多个机构的联合分析在生物医学和流行病学研究中日益重要，尤其是在数据集通常较小的罕见病研究中。然而，隐私法规和机构政策往往阻止共享个体层面的患者数据。在本文中，我们提出了一种准确且单次通信的联邦推理算法。单次通信联邦推理通过参与中心与协调服务器之间仅一次汇总统计信息的交换来实现统计分析，在保护隐私的同时，相比迭代式联邦学习减少了通信和计算成本。我们扩展了一种近期提出的基于二阶泰勒展开的单次通信联邦推理策略，通过使用三阶展开来更好地近似局部对数似然函数。所提出的方法通过模拟研究进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于三阶泰勒展开的单次通信联邦推理算法，通过一次汇总统计交换即可实现准确统计分析，在保护隐私的同时显著降低通信和计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a single-communication federated inference algorithm based on third-order Taylor expansions, enabling accurate statistical analysis through one exchange of summary statistics while preserving privacy and reducing communication and computational costs.
